metas.name: Disclosure Day
metas.description: If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?

metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: Clark, an angry architect, chases the source of impossible power failures when a glowing gap opens in his basement, but the yellow maze beyond it threatens his sanity, his friends, and Mary.

metas.name: Practical Magic 2
metas.description: A multi generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Practical Magic
metas.description: Two witch sisters, raised by their eccentric aunts in a small town, face closed-minded prejudice and a curse which threatens to prevent them ever finding lasting love.

metas.name: Hocus Pocus
metas.description: A teenage boy named Max and his little sister move to Salem, where he struggles to fit in before awakening a trio of diabolical witches that were executed in the 17th century.

metas.name: Dracula

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: Two magicians dismantle their lives to outmaneuver each other following a shared tragedy. They chase the ultimate illusion across Victorian London, sacrificing sanity and safety to master a teleportation feat that defies all logic.

metas.name: Masters of the Universe
metas.description: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
metas.description: An orphaned boy enrolls in a school of wizardry, where he learns the truth about himself, his family and the terrible evil that haunts the magical world.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Casper
metas.description: An afterlife therapist and his daughter meet a friendly young ghost when they move into a crumbling mansion in order to rid the premises of wicked spirits.

metas.name: Inception
metas.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

metas.name: Sleepy Hollow
metas.description: Ichabod Crane is sent to Sleepy Hollow to investigate the decapitations of three people; the culprit is legendary apparition The Headless Horseman.

metas.name: Doctor Sleep
metas.description: Years following the events of The Shining (1980), a now-adult Dan Torrance must protect a young girl with similar powers from a cult known as The True Knot, who prey on children with powers to remain immortal.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

metas.name: The Hunger Games
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen voluntarily takes her younger sister's place in the Hunger Games: a televised competition in which two teenagers from each of the twelve Districts of Panem are chosen at random to fight to the death.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
metas.description: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: The Addams Family
metas.description: Con artists plan to fleece an eccentric family using an accomplice who claims to be their long-lost uncle.

metas.name: The Thing
metas.description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

metas.name: Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

metas.name: Nosferatu
metas.description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

metas.name: Superman
metas.description: Superman must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as reporter Clark Kent. As the embodiment of truth, justice and the American way he soon finds himself in a world that views these as old-fashioned.

metas.name: The Matrix
metas.description: A computer hacker discovers that his life is nothing more than an elaborate simulation run by an evil AI.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

metas.name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
metas.description: Four siblings wind up entering the magical land of Narnia. Once there, they discover a world inhabited by fantastical creatures and find themselves in a battle to defeat a witch.

metas.name: Bugonia
metas.description: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

metas.name: The Life of Chuck
metas.description: A life-affirming, genre-bending story about three chapters in the life of an ordinary man named Charles Krantz.

metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: A special military unit fights a powerful, out-of-control supercomputer and hundreds of scientists who have mutated into flesh-eating creatures after a laboratory accident.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

metas.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

metas.name: Companion
metas.description: A weekend getaway with friends at a remote cabin turns into chaos after it's revealed that one of the guests is not what they seem.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: At an archaeological dig in the ancient city of Hamunaptra, an American serving in the French Foreign Legion accidentally awakens a mummy who begins to wreak havoc as he searches for the reincarnation of his long-lost love.

metas.description: When Tony Stark and Bruce Banner try to jump-start a dormant peacekeeping program called Ultron, things go horribly wrong and it's up to Earth's mightiest heroes to stop the villainous Ultron from enacting his terrible plan.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: Follow the final recruits of a grueling special ops boot camp who encounter a mysterious deadly force.

metas.name: The Green Mile
metas.description: A death row guard learns that a gentle giant in his charge possesses a mysterious gift.

metas.name: Mickey 17
metas.description: During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Homecoming

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: Pan's Labyrinth

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
metas.description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

metas.name: Blade Runner

metas.name: The Running Man

metas.name: The Witch

metas.name: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes

metas.name: Barbie

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

metas.name: Donnie Darko

metas.name: The Avengers
metas.description: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

metas.name: Constantine
metas.description: Detective Angela approaches Constantine, a demon hunter, to help her investigate her twin sister's mysterious death. As he digs deeper, he realizes that demons are trying to enter the human world.

metas.name: A Clockwork Orange
metas.description: Alex DeLarge and his droogs barbarize a decaying near-future.

metas.name: 28 Years Later
metas.description: A group of survivors of the rage virus live on a small island. When one of the group leaves the island on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other su...

metas.name: V for Vendetta
metas.description: A young woman living in a dystopian society meets a shadowy freedom fighter who is plotting to overthrow their tyrannical government.

metas.name: The Terminator

metas.name: Edward Scissorhands

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers

metas.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
metas.description: Captain Jack Sparrow searches for the Trident of Poseidon to rule the sea while being pursued by old rival Captain Salazar and a crew of deadly ghosts who have escaped from the Devil's Triangle.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
metas.description: Harry Potter lives his second year at Hogwarts with Ron and Hermione when a message on the wall announces that the legendary Chamber of Secrets has been opened. The trio soon realize that, to save the school, it will take a lot of...

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

metas.name: The Martian
metas.description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive and arrange a potential rescue.

metas.name: Interview with the Vampire: The Vampire Chronicles
